# Owned support cards

- Last updated: 2026-10-15, from roster screenshots. Cards were matched to uma.guide art by Claude; names and IDs come from uma.guide (Global).
- Totals: 100 cards. 62 SSR (34 MLB) and 38 SR (28 MLB).

LB runs 0–4, and 4 is MLB. The maximum level depends on rarity and LB, so a level above the cap means the row has a mistake:

| Rarity | LB0 | LB1 | LB2 | LB3 | LB4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SSR | 30 | 35 | 40 | 45 | 50 |
| SR | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40 | 45 |
| R | 20 | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40 |

ID links open the card's uma.guide page.
